evidence.title: File:Liat Portal for Foodie Disorder - Creamy Tomato Seafood Pasta.jpg
evidence.description: High-quality photograph by Liat Portal showing pasta prepared with fresh shrimp and calamari, cooked in a tomato sauce enriched with whipping cream and cherry tomatoes. The dish reflects everyday Mediterranean home cooking made with accessible ingredients and minimal technique. This image supports future educational use focused on cooking by time, cooking by budget, and cooking when ingredient variety is limited. It also contributes to a growing visual archive documenting how simple home meals function as cultural memory, food literacy, and long-term resilience assets. These pieces are intentionally distributed across platforms to preserve knowledge, reinforce identity, and increase future optionality and safety through accumulated practical examples. This image is part of the Foodie Disorder global food culture archive.

evidence.title: File:Liat Portal for Foodie Disorder - Ptitim with fresh salad.jpg
evidence.description: High-quality photograph by Liat Portal showing cooked ptitim, Israeli couscous, lightly seasoned and plated beside a chopped salad made from lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and bell pepper. The dish is served simply on a white plate with no garnish or decorative styling. This image documents a finished home-cooked meal, cooking by time rather than technique, and everyday home cooking, emphasizing easy-to-make, reliable ingredients, and repeatable results rather than culinary skill. Photographed in San Francisco. This image documents simple balanced meals and food literacy as part of the Foodie Disorder global food culture archive.
